omitted.analytics.monthSummary: MCP exposes caller-selected date ranges through the spend and product rollups; the calendar-month snapshot remains a home-screen query.
omitted.product.delete: Product catalog mutations remain in the operator curation UI; MCP is read-only.
omitted.product.deleteAlias: Product alias mutations remain in the operator curation UI; MCP is read-only.
omitted.product.list: Canonical product catalog browsing remains in the operator curation UI; assistant product questions use search and purchase analytics.
omitted.product.propose: Product proposals change catalog state and remain in the operator curation UI; MCP is read-only.
omitted.product.rename: Product identity changes remain in the operator curation UI; MCP is read-only.
omitted.product.updateAlias: Product alias mutations remain in the operator curation UI; MCP is read-only.
omitted.purchase.attachDocument: Document links change purchase records and remain in the operator workflow; MCP is read-only.
omitted.purchase.create: Adapter ingestion must provide a source-computed checksum; the model cannot author a captured purchase.
omitted.purchase.createInventoryItem: This creates an inventory record; assistant tools do not write inventory.
omitted.purchase.createManual: Manual purchase creation changes ledger data; MCP is read-only.
omitted.purchase.decideInventoryProposal: A person must decide an inventory proposal; the assistant cannot assert that decision.
omitted.purchase.delete: Deleting purchase records remains an operator action; MCP is read-only.
omitted.purchase.eraseCaptureLocation: Privacy erasure is an operator action and is not exposed to the assistant.
omitted.purchase.listInventoryProposals: Inventory proposals are reviewed in the operator workflow and are not part of assistant purchase answers.
omitted.purchase.patchItem: Line-item classification is a human assertion; the assistant cannot write or confirm it.
omitted.purchase.tagVocabulary: Tag vocabulary feeds operator controls; assistant retrieval uses a caller-supplied tag through items.byTag.
omitted.purchase.update: Purchase record edits remain in the operator workflow; MCP is read-only.
omitted.receipt.extract: Receipt extraction belongs to the capture and OCR workflow, not assistant purchase queries.
omitted.receipt.read: Receipt document review stays in the document workflow; MCP purchase tools return structured purchase data.
omitted.receipt.saveDraft: Receipt drafts are writes in the capture workflow; MCP is read-only.
omitted.receipt.thumbnail: Receipt thumbnails are binary document content and are not exposed through the structured MCP purchase surface.
omitted.receipt.upload: Receipt upload is a binary ingest operation; MCP is read-only.
omitted.reconcile.confirm: Confirming a reconciliation is a human financial assertion; the assistant cannot write it.
omitted.reconcile.links: Reconciliation links are operator review data, not part of assistant purchase answers.
omitted.reconcile.linksBatch: Batch reconciliation links are operator review data, not part of assistant purchase answers.
omitted.reconcile.queue: The reconciliation queue is an operator workflow surface and is not exposed to the assistant.
omitted.reconcile.reject: Rejecting a reconciliation is a human financial assertion; the assistant cannot write it.
omitted.reconcile.sweep: Reconciliation sweeps mutate matching state and remain an operator action.
omitted.reconcile.unlink: Unlinking financial records is a human financial decision; the assistant cannot write it.
omitted.source.delete: Deleting connector configuration is an operator administration action; MCP is read-only.
omitted.source.get: Connector configuration is operator administration data, not a purchase-answer surface.
omitted.source.list: Connector configuration is operator administration data, not a purchase-answer surface.
omitted.source.upsert: Connector configuration writes remain in operator administration; MCP is read-only.
